mainEntity.name: How long do minor framing adjustments usually take, and why do some take longer than expected?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on access and what is found behind the finishes. A simple correction can sometimes be completed in a day, while a small repair that exposes hidden damage, requires drying time, or needs follow-up inspection can take longer. In Denver-area homes, weather, moisture, and scheduling around other trades can also affect timing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small framing corrections can sometimes be done in a day, but hidden damage, moisture issues, or inspection needs can extend the timeline. The biggest variable is what is discovered after the wall, floor, or ceiling is opened.
